_readme: Hand-checked Google matches. extract_google.py obeys these on every run, before any matching rule.
Key: the restaurant's osm_id (copy it from data/review/google_match_review.json).
place_id: the correct Google place ID (google.place_id in the review file), or null when the restaurant has no Google match.
note: why you decided it (optional, for you).
Example: "123456789": {"place_id": "ChIJ...", "note": "same shop, checked on Google Maps"}

The admin review page (/admin, Google matches) writes this file too, adding decided_by (the admin's username) and decided_at. The nightly update (run_update.py) applies a new or changed place_id that night; a note alone starts nothing.

pin (optional): "google" saves Google's pin in the database instead of OSM's (run_3_merging.py reads it). Without it OSM's pin is used. The admin review page offers it when the pins are more than 50 m apart.
